description: The 20 February Bratislava march lead has no visible crowd count or qualitative size estimate. The separate 19-person detention claim is not a turnout measure.
required_followup: Seek an independent contemporaneous count, official attendance estimate, or credible crowd description; do not infer the threshold from detentions.

description: The captured titles refer to a freedom march and an invitation to police, but do not identify a sufficiently specific demand directed to the Slovak state or policy.
required_followup: Review accessible full reporting and organizer material for the demand, recipient, and policy target; leave demand categories empty until established.

description: All seven response values remain unknown. A search-only snippet mentions police encircling/blocking movement; a separate archive repeats a 19-detention claim whose date, original source/origin, and event link are unknown. Neither supports coding a response yet.
required_followup: Identify the original contemporaneous report and official police record, establish whether the 19-person claim concerns this event, and verify each response category separately.

description: All eight source cards remain search_only. The exact SHO URL produced one ordinary retrieval cache miss with no HTTP response/status or article body. The later fresh receipt/manual-review pair was not followed by a request after phase closure. No denial was observed.
required_followup: Only if a future source-access phase is authorized, use a new exact-URL check/review chain and ordinary request; do not treat this cache miss as a denial or rely on the unused chain as a read.

description: STG001 is published by a participant-affiliated organization. STG002 is a pre-event announcement that may refer to the same march, but identity is unverified. STG003 repeats a 19-detention claim without identifying its original reporting source. Independent corroboration and source-origin relationships are not established.
required_followup: Find independent contemporary reporting or official records and trace any syndicated/copied origin before treating the leads as corroboration.

description: January 2021 Slovak events and continuations files are empty; no cross-month continuation into February is established. Whether the pre-event announcement, SHO post-event report, and possible detention item describe one event is unresolved; geographic ownership beyond Bratislava is also unknown.
required_followup: Compare neighboring-month evidence and identify event organization, participant group, date, venue, and multi-site coordination before linking or assigning ownership.

description: The 28 captured search actions cover English and Slovak, four weekly windows, nationwide terms, Bratislava and several other cities, official/municipal/public-broadcaster domains, rights/university queries, and farmer, union, student, health, police, referendum, and COVID-restriction themes. Returned headers include date/geography noise; this is not a systematic inventory of all regional archives or sectors.
required_followup: Continue regional and sector-specific review, including local reporting and official/rights records for cities and groups not resolved by the captured search results; preserve empty-result and relevance limits.

description: Searches were run in Slovak and English, but there was no independent human-language review or systematic check of regional variants and relevant neighboring-language coverage.
required_followup: Obtain human review of Slovak-language leads and assess whether neighboring-language or regional sources are needed for cross-border and minority reporting.

description: Open-web discovery is not equivalent to the source expansion and coverage described for LexisNexis in the original methodology; search result totals and comprehensive archive coverage are unavailable.
required_followup: Retain the method limitation and compare against equivalent archived news coverage if available; do not infer no events from an empty/noisy result set.
